Card Q&A.a: You may look at all the cards in your security stack without revealing them to your opponent. Then, choose 1 card to add to your hand, reveal only that card to your opponent and add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: What does "You may search your security stack" mean?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may search your security stack, reveal 1 card with [Angel], [Archangel], or [Fallen Angel] in its traits from it, and add it to your hand. If you added a card, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. Then, shuffle your security stack.
[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When you play [LadyDevimon] or [Mirei Mikagura], gain 1 memory.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] While you have a purple Digimon in play, all of your Digimon with [Angel], [Archangel], or [Fallen Angel] in their traits gain ＜Blocker＞.
